title: Channel games
body: Play by posting in the configured Counting or Last Letter channel. Counting expects the next integer and a different member each turn; mistakes reset the next count to 1. Every exact 100 earns a Counting Win. Recliner+ may restore intentional sabotage from the current reset notice; restoration is audited. Last Letter expects a new English/slang word beginning with the previous word's last letter and another member's valid turn. Invalid words cost 1 point without breaking the chain; valid words score 1, or 2 when first and last letters match. First to 50 wins and a fresh round starts automatically.

fields.word: One English word or common slang; names, usernames, abbreviations and repeated words are rejected.
fields.number: The next integer in the counting sequence.

steps: Check the previous valid number or word.
Wait for another member before your next valid turn.
Continue after Counting milestones; Last Letter resets automatically at 50.
